svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint F$NY logo, v7
svg.desc: A soft-rounded mint local tag containing the literal F$NY initials, with the S replaced by a dollar sign. A small zero is placed inside the main tag body directly below the dollar. Shape and internal type share a minus-eight-degree angle. Right and bottom point-and-hole motifs remain exact reflected twins. Paired with the exact unchanged Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
